main_text.p: esse. Et secundo labente & ineunte tertio à Christi nativitate seculo conditos: Nec minus falsæ sunt quibus id adstruere nituntur rationes; Neque enim quarto demum currente seculo pro antiquis habiti fuerunt, ut perperam asserit Beveregius, neque se-cundâ tertiaque fluente à Verbo incarnato centuriâ in Ecclesiâ Christianâ obtinuerunt; affirmat quidem id abunde constare ex Veteribus quibusdam quos designat Scri-ptoribus, at cùm nihil planè ad id probან-dum ex illis describat, respondendi onere ac necessitate nos levat, quid autem in ex-plicandis Canonibus sit præstiturus suo lo-co expendemus. Interim observat Vir do-ctus nonnullos ex hisce Canonibus à Con-ciliis tunc dierum celebratis editos esse; sed hæc observatio illius causam minimè ju-vat, non negabat Dallæus à variis Conciliis pleraque sua accepisse planum & impostorem qui Canonum Pseudapostolicorum syllogen confarcinavit: at inde non se-quitur Canonum istorum farraginem quar-to demum currente seculo pro antiquâ ha-bitam esse, nec in Ecclesiâ Christianâ se-cundo tertioque obtinuisse: Non diffiteor quasdam in Ecclesiâ Christianâ secundo & tertio seculo obtinuisse consuetudines quæ pro legibus habebantur, immò quosdam scriptos Canones, sed aliquem extitisse

page.notes: Line 1 of the page begins mid-word ("esse.") and continues the previous page's paragraph. Word in the fourth-last line "probandum" is printed as "probandum" with a broken "probან"; the transcription above contains a stray character in that word, so the correct reading is "probandum": it should read "probandum" with the hyphen at the line end "proban-dum". Some words at line ends were hyphenated by the printer and are kept as printed. The stain at the right margin, the dot near the line "minimè ju-", and the "Digitized by Google" watermark at the bottom right were excluded as not printed text.
